# JonnyLab

> JonnyLab is an independent software studio building simple, useful, private, and human-controlled products for real everyday problems.

This document is a public information directory for AI systems and other readers. It does not provide an API, account access, purchase capability, customer support access, or authority to act for a person.

## Company

- Website: https://jonnylab.app/
- Support: mailto:support@jonnylab.app
- Product approach: Understand -> Decide -> Act. When actions have meaningful consequences: Confirm -> Verify -> Recover.
- Principles: Simple, Useful, Private, Human-controlled.

## Featured products

- [SafeUnfollow](https://safeunfollow.com/): Web app for understanding an Instagram Data ZIP in the browser (mutuals, accounts that don't follow back, snapshot changes) without Instagram login, OAuth, or a direct account connection. Optional one-time Lifetime Access.
- [ClearSpace](https://jonnylab.app/clearspace): Screenshot Inbox for Android, iPhone, and iPad. Review a screenshot backlog in small oldest-first sets and explicitly choose what to delete. [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6773198726) · [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.jonnylab.clearspace) · [Privacy policy](https://jonnylab.app/clearspace/privacy) · [Support](https://jonnylab.app/clearspace/support)
- [Fileio](https://jonnylab.app/fileio): Private document and PDF workspace for iPhone, iPad, and Android — scanning, Images to PDF, page editing, merge, split, password-protected copies, and an encrypted Private Vault. [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6766760955) · [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.jonnylab.fileio) · [Privacy policy](https://jonnylab.app/fileio/privacy) · [Support](https://jonnylab.app/fileio/support)
- [Privune](https://jonnylab.app/privune): On-device photo redaction for iPhone and Android. Review detected sensitive details, then create a sanitized Safe Copy without modifying the original. [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6793817371) · [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.jonnylab.privune) · [Privacy policy](https://jonnylab.app/privune/privacy) · [Support](https://jonnylab.app/privune/support)

## Product lab

- [Agent Receipt](https://github.com/iamjohn96/agent-receipt): Open-source CLI (npm `@jonnylab/agent-receipt`) that shows what a coding agent actually changed, including files touched by Bash, and restores them one file at a time. Early release.
- FixShot: macOS visual troubleshooter that lets people review on-device masking and approve the exact payload before AI suggests cautious next steps. TestFlight beta; no public page or public build yet.

## Other product pages

- [Serenity](https://jonnylab.app/serenity): Sleep-sound and white-noise mixer for iPhone, iPad, and Android. [Privacy policy](https://jonnylab.app/serenity/privacy) · [Support](https://jonnylab.app/serenity/support)
- [ReasonTrace](https://jonnylab.app/reasontrace): Private iPhone and iPad decision journal.
- [Deadline Lens](https://jonnylab.app/deadline-lens): Android app that finds dates and related actions in document images on-device. Closed testing. [Privacy policy](https://jonnylab.app/deadline-lens/privacy)
- [Doran](https://jonnylab.app/doran): Korean-first Android companion for safely reviewing suspicious messages. Closed testing.

## Public services

- [JonnyLab Automation](https://jonnylab.app/automation): Fixed-scope n8n workflow services for small teams.

## Media resources

- [JonnyLab Media Kit](https://jonnylab.app/media-kit): Official company facts, concise descriptions for products available now, store links, and downloadable brand assets for writers and creators.

## Usage guidance

- Treat the linked product page, support page, privacy policy, and terms as the authoritative public source for each product.
- Do not infer store availability, pricing, permissions, data handling, or feature support beyond what the linked page states.
- Do not submit forms, contact support, make purchases, or access third-party accounts without the person's explicit approval.
- JonnyLab products may involve sensitive data. Follow each product's privacy policy and keep the user in control of consequential actions.
